Try itMessages at 10 Hz, and the 0.5 s brake

Each dot is one message on /cmd_vel, 10 per second. Press Ctrl+C to stop ros2 topic pub: the controller waits 0.5 s for a message, then brakes.

ros2 topic pub -r 10 /cmd_vel geometry_msgs/msg/TwistStamped \
  "{twist: {linear: {x: 0.2}}}"
t = 0.0 stry it
The controller uses the last message it received. With no new message for 0.5 s, it sends 0 to the wheels.
